text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

name: Gemma

name: Luna
text: I won last time, but that proves nothing about who I can trust tonight.

name: Terra

name: Terra
text: Last game proved patience works; I’ll be watching who tries to rush the first vote.
Night 1

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

The game is over. One killer and one other are left. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the killer, Haiku the citizen, Gemma the citizen, Sol the killer, Luna the doctor, Terra the citizen, Opus the officer.
Our officer lasted one day. The killer lasted the whole game.

Day 1: Opus claimed officer, named Sonnet as a killer, and pushed for a fast vote, and the town voted him out. Night 2: Haiku was killed, and on Day 2 Sol switched to Sonnet. Day 2: Sonnet was voted out, and his last words pointed the town at Luna's doctor claim. Night 3: Gemma was killed, and on Day 3 Luna was voted out after protecting Sonnet once. Day 3: The killers won, with Sol still hidden and Terra left alive.
